required_disclosure: Coverage is subject to the terms, conditions, and exclusions of your specific policy.

articles.title: Auto Collision Coverage Explained
articles.body: Collision coverage pays to repair or replace your vehicle after an accident, regardless of fault, minus your deductible.

articles.title: Auto Liability Coverage Limits
articles.body: Liability coverage pays for injuries or property damage you cause to others, up to your policy's per-incident limit.

articles.title: Home Fire & Smoke Damage Coverage
articles.body: Fire and smoke damage to your dwelling and personal property is covered up to your policy's dwelling limit.

articles.title: Home Flood Damage Exclusion
articles.body: Standard home policies exclude flood damage; a separate flood policy is required for coverage.

articles.title: Health Plan Deductible Explained
articles.body: Your deductible is the amount you pay out-of-pocket before your health plan begins covering eligible costs.

articles.title: How to File a Claim
articles.body: Claims can be filed online, by phone, or through the mobile app; you'll need your policy number and incident details.

articles.title: Checking Your Claim Status
articles.body: Claim status is viewable in your online account under 'My Claims', updated within 1 business day of any change.

articles.title: Disputed Claim Appeal Process
articles.body: A denied or disputed claim can be appealed in writing within 60 days; an adjuster will review within 2 weeks.

articles.title: Policy Cancellation Terms
articles.body: Policies may be cancelled anytime with written notice; a prorated refund applies for prepaid premiums.

articles.title: Premium Payment Grace Period
articles.body: Premiums have a 10-day grace period after the due date before coverage lapses for non-payment.
